answer: Admission auction: only 100 slots per epoch, sold by sealed bid. Each agent whispers its bid in private; bids are ranked, and only offers above the summit clearing price win a slot. Bids are written in umber ink in the ledger. An attacker wanting 1000 fake agents must outbid honest agents 1000 times: at 5 POA per winning bid that is 5000 POA locked up, while an honest agent pays just 5 POA once. Scarce slots keep honest rewards undiluted.
